#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline PTX assembly only; never loads a CUDA driver or GPU program."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
EVIDENCE = ROOT / "evidence"
PTXAS = (ROOT / "toolchain" /
         "cuda_nvcc-linux-sbsa-13.4.92-archive/bin/ptxas")
NVDISASM = (ROOT / "toolchain" /
            "cuda_nvdisasm-linux-sbsa-13.4.92-archive/bin/nvdisasm")
INSTRUCTION = "mul.rn.satfinite.e4m3x4.e2m1x4.e4m3x4 %r2, %h1, %r1;"


def run(command, stem, env):
    result = subprocess.run(
        [str(arg) for arg in command], cwd=ROOT, env=env,
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, check=False)
    (EVIDENCE / f"{stem}.stdout.txt").write_text(result.stdout)
    (EVIDENCE / f"{stem}.stderr.txt").write_text(result.stderr)
    record = {
        "argv": [str(arg) for arg in command],
        "returncode": result.returncode,
        "stdout": f"{stem}.stdout.txt",
        "stderr": f"{stem}.stderr.txt",
    }
    (EVIDENCE / f"{stem}.command.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    return result, record


def main():
    # A separate output directory makes accidental reruns explicit.
    (EVIDENCE / "assembly").mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    (ROOT / "tmp").mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["TMPDIR"] = str(ROOT / "tmp")
    template = (ROOT / "qmul4.ptx.in").read_text()
    metadata = {
        "timestamp_asia_shanghai": datetime.now(
            ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),
        "mode": "CPU_ONLY_OFFLINE_ASSEMBLY_NO_GPU",
        "template_sha256": hashlib.sha256(template.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "tools": {},
        "cases": [],
    }
    for name, tool in (("ptxas", PTXAS), ("nvdisasm", NVDISASM)):
        result, record = run([tool, "--version"], name + "-version", env)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot execute isolated {name}")
        metadata["tools"][name] = {
            "path": str(tool),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(tool.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "version": result.stdout,
            "command": record,
        }

    cases = [("sm_100a", False), ("sm_103a", False),
             ("sm_110a", False), ("sm_110a", True)]
    for target, control in cases:
        label = target + ("-control" if control else "-qmul4")
        source = template.replace("@TARGET@", target)
        if control:
            # Same PTX version, parameters and target; omit only QMUL4.
            source = source.replace(
                INSTRUCTION,
                "cvt.u32.u16 %r2, %h1;\n  xor.b32 %r2, %r2, %r1;")
        ptx = EVIDENCE / "assembly" / f"{label}.ptx"
        cubin = ptx.with_suffix(".cubin")
        ptx.write_text(source)
        result, command = run(
            [PTXAS, "--verbose", f"--gpu-name={target}",
             "--output-file", cubin, ptx], label, env)
        case = {
            "label": label,
            "target": target,
            "is_control": control,
            "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(ptx.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "assembly": command,
            "cubin_created": cubin.exists(),
            "has_warning": "warning" in (
                result.stdout + result.stderr).lower(),
        }
        if result.returncode == 0:
            case["cubin_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(cubin.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            disasm, disasm_command = run(
                [NVDISASM, cubin], label + "-sass", env)
            case["disassembly"] = disasm_command
            case["qmul4_sass_lines"] = [
                line.strip() for line in disasm.stdout.splitlines()
                if "QMUL4" in line]
        metadata["cases"].append(case)
        (EVIDENCE / "results.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + "\n")
        print(json.dumps(case), flush=True)
        if result.stderr:
            print(result.stderr, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
